description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing synchronization state within a Room database, including methods to retrieve the last synchronization timestamp and upsert sync state entities.

classes.name: SyncStateDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for sync state, providing database operations such as retrieving last sync time and upserting sync state.

methods.name: getLastSyncAt
methods.description: Suspending function that queries the last sync timestamp for a given key from the 'sync_state' table.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Suspending function that inserts or updates a SyncStateEntity in the database with conflict resolution set to REPLACE.
